messages.subject: TidyLPA
parts:
Dear Joshua M. Rosenberg,


Hopefully, you can help me with some questions regarding the R package tidyLPA. First of all, my name is Denise Blom and I am a PhD student in Health psychology at University Medical Center Groningen (UMCG) in the Netherlands. I have been working with your package for quite some time already but I got some problems/questions with the performance of this package on my current data.


  1. I used estimate_profiles() to perform LPA. In order to get multiple fit indices, I used get_fit(). This all works fine without any warnings. However, as you can see in the attached document, the values of loglikelihood and ICL are in red. Can you explain to me why this is the case? Is there something going wrong with the estimation of the indices?
  2. Furthermore, on many indices and based on interpretation of the clusters we would conclude that the 2 cluster solution would be optimal. However, the BLRT is very high for this cluster solution (although the p-value is significant). Can you explain to me how this value can be this high for the 2 cluster solution and not for the other solutions?

If you have any relevant literature for me that might answer my questions, that would be great!

Thank you in advance.

Kind regards,
Denise Blom
